summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with fever and bilateral leg pain, following a recent episode of line sepsis and PICC removal. He has a complex history including ESRD on hemodialysis, non-ischemic cardiomyopathy, and seizure disorder. During admission, his fever resolved without antipyretics, and he became afebrile within 24 hours. Blood cultures were pending at discharge, with suspicion for S. aureus bacteremia. He developed a clotted AV graft during dialysis on hospital day two, necessitating a planned declotting procedure. Due to work concerns, the patient chose to leave against medical advice before completing IV antibiotics or the procedure. He was discharged home with instructions to continue home medications, attend dialysis, and return if symptoms worsened.
problems: Other complications due to renal dialysis device, implant, and graft
